NSCameraUsageDescription: EduLoc uses the camera for video calls with your tutor or your student.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: EduLoc uses the microphone to record your voice messages and make calls.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: EduLoc accesses your photo library so you can select your presentation video.
NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: EduLoc uses your location to find tutors near you.
